construction_method: Development-time-only fetch of first-party official Pokemon sources via HTTPS GET (curl, User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0), archived verbatim as retrieved into evidence/*.html. No runtime network access; this manifest and the paired rules.snapshot.json are the only inputs the running application ever reads.
notes: Source A (news.pokemon-home.com/ja/page/803.html) confirms Ranked Battles Season M-5, Regulation M-B, season period 2026-08-05 through 2026-09-09 10:59 JST, and that Ranked Battles has separate Single Battle and Double Battle rule surfaces.

Source B (news.pokemon-home.com/ja/page/776.html) confirms Regulation M-B usage period 2026-06-17 through 2026-09-09 10:59 JST (note: the page states the window was extended from an originally planned 2026-09-02 end date to 2026-09-09, updated 2026-08-05); eligible-Pokemon-only participation; certain eligible Pokemon holding a Mega Stone can Mega Evolve; Mega Evolution usable only once per battle; duplicate held items among participating Pokemon prohibited; Total Time 20 minutes; Player Time 7 minutes; turn selection time 45 seconds; Pokemon selection time 90 seconds.

Source C (web-view.app.pokemonchampions.jp .../ic178290276185tpuhen/en/event.html) is titled 'Monthly Challenge Series July 2026', not literally labelled 'Regulation M-B' in the page itself -- this is a discrepancy against the prior audit's framing of this URL as a 'Regulation M-B Single Battle event' page. It is used here only as numeric/format corroboration, because its Battle Format (Single Battle), No. of Pokemon Able to Battle (3), Eligible Mechanics (Mega Evolution), and Time Limits (Total Time 20 minutes / Your Time 7 minutes / Move Time 45 seconds / Pokemon Selection Time 90 seconds) figures match Source B's Regulation M-B figures exactly. No fact in rules.snapshot.json rests on Source C alone.
